No brand, country-of-origin stamp, or manufacturer mark visible; only a generic logo/emblem that cannot confirm origin.

risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped capacity/tare weight on the collar or shoulder of the cylinder
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/smallest common size until stamp is shown

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty rather than filled
risks.proof: Weighing video or scale photo showing gross weight, or gas-level check

risks.risk: Valve or threading may be damaged or incompatible with standard regulators
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of valve threads and a regulator test-fit

risks.risk: No visible certification or inspection date, cylinder age/safety unknown
risks.proof: Photo of stamped manufacture/inspection date on the cylinder neck

risks.risk: Hidden dents, rust, or corrosion under the netting
risks.proof: Photos with netting partially removed showing bare metal body
Photo showing regulator/hose alongside cylinder if included

proof_requests: Weighing scale photo or video showing fill level
Close-up of valve threads, possibly with regulator attached
Photo with netting pulled back to show bare cylinder body
Photo confirming whether regulator/hose is included
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a cooking gas cylinder, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown/smallest capacity, assumed empty, uncertified, possible damage) pending the listed proofs.
